name: Callisto
pages: Callisto is found near Jupiter. Look for the cobbled deepslate structure with lots of ice.$(br2)Natural resources: iron, redstone, callistoan dust (pink lunar dust).$(br)Mobs: Voided, Skeletons, SpaceFellows, Lunar Slimes

pages.text: Callisto bricks can be used to craft a portal to Callisto, and then lit using flint & steel.$(br)This does mean you need to visit Callisto for the first time using the spaceship, or be in creative mode!$(br2)Note: portals can only be used to or from the overworld!
Check out some fun facts about Callisto, courtesy of NASA!
